name: Majority-Closed Partial Cube
statement: In an isometric hypercube representation, the vertex family is closed under coordinatewise majority: for all $A,B,C$, the set $(A\cap B)\cup(A\cap C)\cup(B\cap C)$ is again a vertex.
hypotheses: Finite partial cube in any irredundant hypercube representation.
comments: The condition is invariant under coordinate permutations, reflections, and addition or removal of constant coordinates.
